confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors use London-specific aggregated price data last updated 11 June 2026, cross-checked against a July 2026 London guide. Cocktail is estimated near the middle of that guide's low-to-mid-teens range; wine is estimated at about 1.3 times the local draft-beer price. Accommodation is a holistic estimate and varies substantially by area, date and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: London-specific food and drink prices are available, so no comparable city was needed; accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of London as a high-cost European capital.
